title: A nested VAR block may define a variable with the name of the variable being defined around it
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR Result = SUMX ( T, VAR Result = T[n] * 10 RETURN Result ) RETURN Result )

source.quote: Please note that we used the Result variable twice. The inner Result is valid in the inner block, whereas the outer Result is valid in the outer box.
source.supports: the article defines Result inside the SUMX that defines the outer Result

derivation: T[n] is 1, 2, 3. The inner Result is n * 10 in each row: 10, 20, 30. SUMX gives 60, which is the outer Result. Integer times integer is an integer.
